metric.citationTooltip: Grounding pass rate: the share of returned findings whose cited lines exist in the diff. It does not check that the citation is correct.
metric.recallTooltip: Share of must-find cases where a matching finding was returned.
metric.precisionTooltip: Share of returned findings that matched a must-find case.
metric.passedTooltip: Cases that passed out of the cases in the run.
metric.deltaTooltip: Change in percentage points against the previous finished run.
metric.drift: Metrics are from v{from}; the agent is now v{to}. Run all evals to update.

scoring.note: Scoring is mechanical: a finding counts when the file matches and line ranges overlap. No model call in the scorer.
scoring.recall: Recall is the number of must-find cases that were hit by a matching finding, divided by the number of must-find cases.
scoring.precision: Precision is the number of returned findings that matched a must-find case, divided by all findings returned. A finding that matches nothing counts against it.
scoring.citation: Citation accuracy is the grounding pass rate: grounded findings divided by grounded plus dropped findings. It measures whether the cited lines exist in the diff, not whether the citation is right.
scoring.limitSemantic: Line matching is not semantic: a finding on the right lines for the wrong reason counts as a match.
scoring.limitShifted: A finding on shifted lines next to the real problem can miss.

run.confirm: Run {count, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}} with {model}? Each case makes one review call to the model.
run.noCases: Add at least one eval case to run evals.
run.errorFallback: Could not start the eval run.
